notes.title: Added teleport & Few bugs fixed
notes.content:
Added teleport:
A new teleportation feature has been introduced, allowing players to quickly move between designated locations within the game world. This feature enhances gameplay by providing faster navigation and strategic movement options, making it easier to traverse large areas or avoid obstacles. The teleportation mechanic has been carefully balanced to ensure it integrates smoothly with existing gameplay elements.

Fixed some bugs:
A number of technical issues have been addressed to improve the overall gameplay experience. These fixes include resolving minor glitches, UI errors, and gameplay inconsistencies. Efforts were made to eliminate performance bottlenecks, fix incorrect animations, and improve interactions within the game environment. Players should experience smoother, more reliable gameplay as a result.
